messages.subject: Project Quartz - draft funds flow & completion statement
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor, Dan,

Ahead of completion on Friday 13 Feb, attached are the draft funds flow and completion statement.

Sources: £22.0m equity from Ardenfield Fund IV + £15.0m Northbank term loan = £37.0m.
Uses: £35.25m completion payment, £1.5m retention, plus furnace lease redemption (£214k), W&I premium (£168k), legals, SDRT (£176,250) and bank fees.

Equity value is £38.75m (EV £42.5m less £3.75m estimated net debt). The deferred £2.0m is payable on the first anniversary and is not in Friday's flow.

Please confirm the Fund IV and Northbank amounts so we can finalise.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
